proof_summary: Johnson-edge crossings correspond to twice the number of mixed triples of an additive pair-weight threshold graph. Each threshold creation word gives an exact suffix-balance sum bounded sharply by Mantel-type products. Generic centered arithmetic normals attain every bound term.
